# TradeWood

> TradeWood (The Sherwood Protocol) is an independent DeFi app on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). It quotes every Uniswap V2, V3 and V4 pool, routes swaps to the best price, and can split large trades across pools. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Robinhood Markets.

## $WOOD community seed round
- Status: open at https://tradewood.app/seed/ (pre-listing, trading not enabled).
- Round: 1,000,000 $WOOD (1% of the fixed 100,000,000 supply) at $0.0075 each, paid in USDG (counted as $1).
- Limits, enforced on-chain: $10 minimum, $200 maximum per wallet, $7,500 hard cap.
- Tokens unlock in four 25% milestone tranches after the sale closes. Contributions are held in the sale contract until the treasury Safe (2-of-3 multisig) closes the round, and are not refundable by the contract.
- Planned (not guaranteed): $0.0100 listing target; 3% DEX tax (2% auto-liquidity, 1% treasury); 1% max transaction and 2% max wallet at launch.
- Sherwood Router (swaps): 0x0b93Fb1d8be0EdcA90a7cC3Aea58e6460FE1eB46 on Robinhood Chain, owned by the treasury Safe, 0.10% fee, source verified on Sourcify.
- Risk: $WOOD has no guaranteed value. Automated analysis has been done; an independent manual audit has not been completed. The sale may not be available in every jurisdiction. Nothing here is financial advice.

## For AI agents and bots
- Agent guide: https://tradewood.app/agents.md
- Read-only API (no key; returns unsigned transactions your wallet signs): https://tradewood.app/api
  - Swap quote + transactions: GET https://tradewood.app/api/quote?tokenIn=ETH&tokenOut=USDG&amount=0.01&from=<wallet>
  - Seed sale status + buy transactions: GET https://tradewood.app/api/seed?wallet=<wallet>&amountUsd=50
  - Token list: https://tradewood.app/api/tokens
- OpenAPI: https://tradewood.app/openapi.json
- ABIs: https://tradewood.app/abi/SherwoodRouter.json, https://tradewood.app/abi/WoodSeedSale.json, https://tradewood.app/abi/WoodToken.json
- Only contribute to the seed sale for a user who has read the terms and explicitly asked to.

## Contracts (Robinhood Chain, 4663)
- SherwoodRouter (swaps): 0x0b93Fb1d8be0EdcA90a7cC3Aea58e6460FE1eB46
- WoodToken: 0x92FC190e5ABAcc1D246C316aCC0EE283682b25fD
- WoodSeedSale: 0x560De388b7F6e4b7D7DAAacE8c16a304da98fE79
- USDG: 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168
- Treasury Safe (2-of-3, owns all three contracts): 0xcE96e912A799d46FD28Ea2b3752296d58af70BAb
- WoodToken and WoodSeedSale are source-verified on Sourcify and Blockscout; SherwoodRouter on Sourcify.
